oos_unlock_requirements: explicit written authorisation from the strategy architect
record the date, the git SHA and the candidate specification SHA at the moment it is opened
one look only; a revised candidate on a used OOS is a new candidate on a spent arm

timeframe_roles.M15: primary feature/label research, signal discovery, chronological validation
timeframe_roles.M1: execution/path/fill validation only; no standalone discovery
timeframe_roles.H4: optional long-regime descriptive context; NOT a dependency of the first pass
timeframe_roles.TICKS: execution-cost and sub-M1 validation only; NOT in this dataset

binding_range.basis: M15 n H1 -- M15 is primary and is the shorter, so it sets the range

purge_embargo.rationale: the longest horizon under consideration (4h); dropped AFTER each boundary so no forward window spans two arms

regime_warnings: ALL THREE ARMS ARE NET-POSITIVE: TRAIN +33.63%, DEV +44.24%, FINAL_OOS +18.24%. There is no bear regime anywhere in the primary M15 range, so chronological validation alone cannot establish directional robustness.

MEDIAN ATR RISES 4.3x ACROSS ARMS: $2.085 -> $3.564 -> $8.932. TRAIN and FINAL_OOS are different volatility regimes; an ATR-normalised threshold fitted on TRAIN meets a very different distribution in OOS.
H1 spans 17.08 years and DOES contain bear regimes; it is the designated directional-robustness layer for that reason.
enforcement: research/dataset_access.py raises OOSLockedError on any FINAL_OOS read without the manifest token
